Abstract

We counted nuclei in fluorescence images of cultured cells before and after treatment with a test compound.

Results

Image set and segmentation

In total 68 images were analysed, of which 12 were excluded for being out of focus. Across the remaining images the pipeline detected a median of 214 nuclei per image.

Effect of treatment

The fraction of cells in the dividing state was 21% (8%, 48%) in treated wells, compared with 9% (3%, 24%) in control wells. The mean nuclear area was 153.4 square micrometres in the control group.

Methods

Images were acquired at 0.65 micrometres per pixel.
